scenario: A `then ... within` SEQUENCE replayed ([LFST.9.1], [LTHE.2]). `confirm` matches a Door followed by a Motion in the same zone within 30_s. Door a at ts 0, Motion a at ts 10_s (confirmed), Door b at ts 20_s, Motion b at ts 60_s (40_s later, outside the bound, so not confirmed). ⚠ The sequence's time axis is each fact's `ts` slot, an INPUT, not the engine clock: this vector pins that a recording carries what the bound is decided on, not the clock the other LFST.9.1 replay vectors replay. Paths: libds records through `rfcs/codec.c`'s recorder and replays through `ds_rfcs_replay_*` (pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay`), which byte-compares each re-derived RuleFireAnnotation and FactEmit; the Mercury runtime records through `ds.rfcs` and replays through `ds.replay`.
rules_ds:
schema Door scope ttl 1_h:
    zone: String
    ts: Time

schema Motion scope ttl 1_h:
    zone: String
    ts: Time

schema Confirmed scope ttl 1_h:
    zone: String

rule confirm:
    Door d
    then Motion m within 30_s where m.zone == d.zone
->
    emit Confirmed zone: d.zone
